_verificationNote: Addresses below were verified against Aave's official aave-address-book (bgd-labs) and developers.uniswap.org deployment docs / PolygonScan on the date of writing. Uniswap V3 pool addresses for the specific USDC/WMATIC/USDT trio are NOT hardcoded here -- they are resolved on-chain at runtime via UniswapV3Factory.getPool(tokenA, tokenB, fee), because current liquidity depth for a specific hardcoded pool address could not be independently verified from documentation alone and pool liquidity can shift over time. This is also the more robust engineering approach.

aaveV3.note: The premium bps assumption above is only used for OFF-CHAIN pre-trade estimation (optimizer/config default). The authoritative value is always read on-chain via Pool.FLASHLOAN_PREMIUM_TOTAL() or the `premium` argument passed into executeOperation by Aave itself.

uniswapV3.swapRouterNote: This is the original SwapRouter (v1), which includes an explicit `deadline` field required by this system. SwapRouter02 (0x68b3465833fb72A70ecDF485E0e4C7bD8665Fc45) intentionally NOT used because it omits per-call deadline in its param structs.

USDC.note: Native (Circle-issued) USDC on Polygon PoS. NOT the older bridged USDC.e.

USDC_E.note: Legacy PoS-bridged USDC (USDC.e). Historically deeper Uniswap V3 liquidity than native USDC on Polygon for many pairs. Used in routes USDCe-WMATIC-USDT-USDCe and USDCe-WBTC-WMATIC-USDCe.

WMATIC.note: Same contract now commonly displayed as WPOL following the MATIC->POL rebrand; contract address and behavior unchanged.

WETH.note: Wrapped Ether (bridged) on Polygon PoS. This is the canonical WETH used by Uniswap V3 on Polygon.

WBTC.note: Wrapped Bitcoin (bridged) on Polygon PoS. 8 decimals (not 18).

LINK.note: Chainlink Token on Polygon PoS. No Uniswap V3 pools with USDC/WMATIC/USDT -- kept for reference only.

DAI.note: Dai stablecoin on Polygon PoS. Deep Uniswap V3 liquidity with USDC, USDC.e, WMATIC, and USDT.

AAVE.note: Aave Token on Polygon PoS. No Uniswap V3 pools with USDC/WMATIC/USDT -- kept for reference only.

CRV.note: Curve DAO Token on Polygon PoS. Has Uniswap V3 pools with USDC (fee 3000), WMATIC (fee 3000/500), and USDT (fee 500).

pools.note: Pool address/token0/token1/fee/liquidity are NOT hardcoded; resolved and read live on-chain by bot/pools.py via IUniswapV3Factory.getPool() and IUniswapV3Pool (token0/token1/fee/liquidity/slot0). This avoids shipping a stale or unverifiable pool address.
